correctness.rationale: Reconstructed distinct one-deletion descendant sets for weight-two words. For fixed first one i, pairs with second one j and j+1 share two distinct descendants: weight-one word with one at i, and weight-two word obtained by deleting an appropriate zero. Hence at most ceil((n−i−1)/2) choices; sum floor(n²/4). For proposed odd-gap pairs, weight-one descendant positions i,j−1 share parity i; three possible weight-two descendant position pairs have three mutually distinct parity patterns. Same-parity i groups have no shared weight-two descendants; opposite-parity groups cannot have two distinct shared weight-two descendants. Thus all intersections ≤1. Independent full reconstruction graph exhaustive maximum independent-set search for n2..11 confirms formula, including small n=2 boundary, and direct parity witness validity. Infinite theorem based on discrete graph/path argument, not this bounded check.
